llm.summary: This skill is a documentation-writing helper that reads and edits documentation or comments in ways that match its stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: The artifact consistently describes generating or remediating documentation, checking writing quality, loading an optional style profile, and editing docs or comments only.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The trigger list includes broad words such as writing, generation, remediation, and polish, so it may activate for general writing requests, but the runtime instructions narrow behavior to documentation work.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains only markdown skill files and metadata; there are no install scripts, executable payloads, postinstall hooks, or automatic package changes.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Reading .scribe/style-profile.yaml, running local quality checks, and editing documentation are proportionate to a documentation-generation skill.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No credential access, background worker, persistence mechanism, network upload, hidden command execution, or destructive behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install if you want a stricter documentation-writing workflow. Be aware it may activate on broad writing or polish requests, and it can read a local .scribe style profile and edit documentation or comment text when you ask it to remediate files.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad triggers are a usability and activation-scope concern, but artifact instructions are coherent with documentation generation/remediation and do not create a security-level Review concern.
[staticScan] expected: Static scan reported no suspicious patterns, matching the markdown-only artifact contents inspected.
[VirusTotal] expected: VirusTotal telemetry was clean across the supplied engines and is consistent with the local artifact review.
